```{r}
diffbind_objs <- list(Background = dbObj_RLEbackground, Reads_in_peak = dbObj_RLERiP, total_counts = dbObj_RPKMnorm, spike_in=dbObj_sacCer3norm, greenlist = dbObj_greenlistnorm)


```


# Getting values of interest
```{r}
# Function to extract MA plot data from diffbind object
extract_MA_data <- function(diffbind_obj, norm_method_str) {
  #diffbind_obj <- dbObj_greenlistnorm
  COUNTS_DF <- diffbind_obj %>% dba.report(., th = 1) %>% as.data.frame()
  COUNTS_DF <- COUNTS_DF[COUNTS_DF$seqnames %in% paste0("chr",c(1:22,"X","Y")),] # Getting XY and numerical chromosomes only. 
  samples <- colnames(COUNTS_DF)[7:8] %>% gsub("Conc_", "", .)
  plot_title <- paste(samples[1], samples[2], sep = " vs ")
  
  COUNTS_DF$plot_colour <- "unchanged"
  COUNTS_DF$plot_colour[COUNTS_DF$Fold > 0 & COUNTS_DF$FDR < 0.05] <- "up"
  COUNTS_DF$plot_colour[COUNTS_DF$Fold < 0 & COUNTS_DF$FDR < 0.05] <- "down"
  
  down_peaks <- sum(COUNTS_DF$plot_colour == "down")
  up_peaks <- sum(COUNTS_DF$plot_colour == "up")
  
  # Calculate loess smoothing
  loessMod50 <- loess(Fold ~ Conc, data = COUNTS_DF, span = 0.50)
  COUNTS_DF$loess <- predict(loessMod50)
  
  # Add metadata columns
  COUNTS_DF$norm_method <- norm_method_str
  COUNTS_DF$plot_title <- plot_title
  COUNTS_DF$up_peaks <- up_peaks
  COUNTS_DF$down_peaks <- down_peaks
  COUNTS_DF$facet_label <- paste(norm_method_str, "| up:", up_peaks, "down:", down_peaks)
  
  return(COUNTS_DF)
}

# Extract data from all normalization methods
ma_data_list <- list(
  extract_MA_data(dbObj_RPKMnorm, "Library size"),
  extract_MA_data(dbObj_RLEbackground, "Background"),
    extract_MA_data(dbObj_greenlistnorm, "Greenlist"),
  extract_MA_data(dbObj_RLERiP, "Reads in peak"),
  extract_MA_data(dbObj_sacCer3norm, "Spike-in")
)

```

```{r}
# Combine into one big dataframe
combined_ma_data <- bind_rows(ma_data_list)

# Set factor order for normalization methods
combined_ma_data$norm_method <- factor(combined_ma_data$norm_method, 
                                       levels = combined_ma_data$norm_method %>% unique())
```


```{r}
# Everything is plotted in this order: "library size", "background, "greenlist", "RiP, "spike-in"

plotting_order <-combined_ma_data$norm_method %>% unique()

```


```{r}
# Create unique peak identifiers
combined_ma_data$peak_id <- paste(combined_ma_data$seqnames, combined_ma_data$start, combined_ma_data$end, sep = "_")


```

```{r}

fdr_wide <- combined_ma_data %>%
  dplyr::select(peak_id, norm_method, FDR) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = peak_id, names_from = norm_method, values_from = FDR)

# Keep methods in your established plotting order
fdr_mat <- as.matrix(fdr_wide[, as.character(plotting_order)])
rownames(fdr_mat) <- fdr_wide$peak_id
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Writing bedfile for deeptools heatmap

deeptools_peaks <- data.frame(peaks = rownames(fdr_mat)) 
deeptools_peaks <- deeptools_peaks %>% separate(., into = c("chr","start","end"),col = peaks) 

deeptools_peaks$start <- deeptools_peaks$start %>% as.numeric()
deeptools_peaks$end <- deeptools_peaks$end %>% as.numeric()

deeptools_peaks <- data.frame(
  chr   = deeptools_peaks$chr,
  start = deeptools_peaks$start - 1,   # 1-based to 0-based conversion
  end   = deeptools_peaks$end
)

write.table(deeptools_peaks,file = "/data/gpfs/projects/punim2745/03.CUTRUN_normalisation_KA/20241230_BRG1_with_replicates/R_analysis_reviewerresponse/5.Deeptools_heatmap/bedfile/peaks_to_plot.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

```


# Plotting by FDR
```{r}

# Remove peaks that are FDR > 0.5 in every single normalisation method
# (i.e. never even close to significant anywhere - not informative for
# the concordance comparison)
method_names <- as.character(plotting_order)

all_above_0.5 <- rowSums(as.matrix(fdr_mat[, method_names]) > 0.2) == length(method_names)

cat(sprintf("Removing %d of %d peaks (FDR > 0.2 in all %d methods)\n",
            sum(all_above_0.5), nrow(fdr_mat), length(method_names)))

fdr_mat <- fdr_mat[!all_above_0.5, ]
```


## Heatmap
```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=3}
# Custom breaks
breaks <- c(0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)
bin_labels <- paste0(head(breaks, -1), "-", breaks[-1])
bin_midpoints <- head(breaks, -1) + diff(breaks) / 2

# Recreate the default blue-white-red colour ramp, sampled at bin midpoints
default_ramp <- colorRamp2(c(0, 0.2, 1), c("blue", "white", "red"))
bin_colors <- default_ramp(bin_midpoints)
names(bin_colors) <- bin_labels

# Cut the FDR matrix into discrete bins
fdr_mat_binned <- matrix(
  cut(fdr_mat, breaks = breaks, labels = bin_labels, include.lowest = TRUE),
  nrow = nrow(fdr_mat), dimnames = dimnames(fdr_mat)
)
bin_index <- cut(fdr_mat, breaks = breaks, labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)

fdr_mat_mid <- matrix(
  bin_midpoints[bin_index],
  nrow = nrow(fdr_mat), dimnames = dimnames(fdr_mat)
)

# FULL heatmap:
ht_full <- Heatmap(
  fdr_mat_binned,
  name = "FDR",
  col = bin_colors,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_names_side = "top",
  cluster_rows = hclust(dist(fdr_mat_mid))
)
ht_full
```


```{r}
pdf("./FDR_heatmap.pdf", width=3, height = 10)
ht_full
dev.off()
```


```{r}
breaks <- c(0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)
bin_labels <- paste0(head(breaks, -1), "-", breaks[-1])
bin_midpoints <- head(breaks, -1) + diff(breaks) / 2

# Recreate the default blue-white-red colour ramp, sampled at bin midpoints
default_ramp <- colorRamp2(c(0, 0.2, 1), c("blue", "white", "red"))
bin_colors <- default_ramp(bin_midpoints)
names(bin_colors) <- bin_labels

# Cut the FDR matrix into discrete bins
fdr_mat_binned <- matrix(
  cut(fdr_mat, breaks = breaks, labels = bin_labels, include.lowest = TRUE),
  nrow = nrow(fdr_mat), dimnames = dimnames(fdr_mat)
)
bin_index <- cut(fdr_mat, breaks = breaks, labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
fdr_mat_mid <- matrix(
  bin_midpoints[bin_index],
  nrow = nrow(fdr_mat), dimnames = dimnames(fdr_mat)
)


```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=3}
# Order rows by row sum of bin midpoints (ascending = most-significant-overall first)
row_order <- order(rowSums(fdr_mat_mid))

# FULL heatmap:
ht_full <- Heatmap(
  fdr_mat_binned,
  name = "FDR",
  col = bin_colors,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_names_side = "top",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  row_order = row_order
)
ht_full

```

# Plotting by rank order
```{r}
# Rank peaks within each normalisation method by FDR
# (rank 1 = smallest FDR = most significant)
method_names <- as.character(plotting_order)
set.seed(10)
rank_mat <- apply(as.matrix(fdr_wide[, method_names]), 2, rank, ties.method = "random")
rownames(rank_mat) <- rownames(fdr_wide)

# Remove peaks that are never even close to significant in any method
# (i.e. rank is in the bottom 80% - least significant - in every method)
n_peaks <- nrow(rank_mat)
all_low_rank <- rowSums(rank_mat > 0.10 * n_peaks) == length(method_names)
cat(sprintf("Removing %d of %d peaks (bottom 80%% by rank in all %d methods). %d peaks used in heatmap. \n",
            sum(all_low_rank), n_peaks, length(method_names), n_peaks - sum(all_low_rank)))
rank_mat <- rank_mat[!all_low_rank, ]


```


## Heatmap by rank

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width =3}

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(1, n_peaks),
  c('white', 'darkgreen')
)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(1, n_peaks),
  (brewer.pal(9, "YlGn"))[c(1, 9)]  # take only the first and last colour
)

ht_full <- Heatmap(
  rank_mat,
  name = "FDR rank",
  col = col_fun,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_names_side = "top")


ht_full
```



```{r}
pdf("./rank_heatmap.pdf", width=3, height = 10)
ht_full
dev.off()
```
